decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed detached house, by reason of its absence of information about siting, its design, bulk and appearance would be out of character with and unsympathetic to the pattern of development in the area, would detract from the setting and appearance of the original house and the street scene, and would result in the further encroachment of a mature landscaped garden. The proposal would therefore fail to preserve and enhance the St Stephen's Conservation Area, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 and ENV-B 2.2 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) and supplementary planning guidance for the area.

Condition : 2 - Insufficient information has been provided regarding the position of the proposed house in relation to the existing built form, in order for the Local Planning Authority to satisfy itself that the proposal would not either harm the living conditions of the adjoining properties by reason of overlooking, loss of light and outlook, or provide adequate private amenity space for future occupiers, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 3 - The proposal would result in the loss of a garage and fails to provide sufficient off-street parking and access arrangements for both the existing and the proposed house, contrary to policy T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 4 - The drawings submitted are inaccurate and there are discrepancies between the front and rear elevations. As such it would not physically be possible to build the proposal and the local planning authority therefore has no option other than to refuse planning permission.
description: Erection of a detached 3 bedroom dwellinghouse
